jobs.description:

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

The role, in a nutshell:
We're looking for a Director of People Operations to help scale our HR operations function as Chainguard grows and expands internationally. This role will lead our People Operations team, and will own the core employee lifecycle processes — onboarding, offboarding, compliance training, and job changes — as well as our expansion into new countries.

We're currently opening entities in the UK and Canada, with Germany to follow, and expect to open several more countries next year. This role will be central to that effort, working cross-functionally with Finance and Legal to figure out how we operate compliantly, and how we pay and support people, in every country we enter.

What You'll Do

Own and scale Chainguard's core employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, compliance training, and updates for promotions and job changes
Lead the People Operations team, currently one manager with two direct reports
Make HR Operations more visible and accessible to employees
Lead the operational work of opening new legal entities internationally, including the UK, Canada, and Germany, and additional countries planned for next year
Own the ongoing maintenance of HR operations and compliance across all countries where Chainguard operates
Partner cross-functionally with Finance and Legal to navigate the compliance, payroll, and legal constraints of operating in each new country
Manage and expand our partnership with our Employer of Record (EOR) provider, given our reliance on remote employees across roughly 19 countries
Build scalable People Operations processes, templates, and resources as the function and company grow
Bring strong AI fluency to the function, using AI to design smarter, more efficient People Operations processes and improve the employee experience.

What We're Looking For

8–10+ years in HR/People Operations, including 3+ years in a leadership/management capacity
Proven ownership of HRIS strategy — has led an implementation, migration, or major optimization (Workday, Rippling, ADP, or similar)
Experience owning the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, offboarding, org changes, data integrity, and process design
Background managing HR compliance operations — I-9s, leave administration, policy administration, audits
Experience standing up or scaling a people ops function in a high-growth SaaS or startup environment
International experience required, particularly across EMEA; experience in Japan, Singapore, or South America is a strong plus
Direct experience opening new international entities and standing up HR compliance and operations in new countries
Experience partnering with or managing an Employer of Record (EOR) for international employees
A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach — this role needs to be a "yes, how can I help" partner to the business, not a bottleneck or blocker
Strong track record managing and developing a team
Comfort operating with some ambiguity and building process where it doesn't yet exist

Why This Role:
Chainguard is in the middle of an ambitious international expansion, and our People Operations function needs to scale right alongside it. This role will be central to that work building the processes and infrastructure to support employees well, in every country we operate in, while also making HR Operations a more helpful, visible partner to the business day to day.

You'll have real ownership over how People Operations scales globally, with the opportunity to build and grow a team as the company continues to expand.

Base Salary Range

$204,000—$240,000 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

About the Role

This opportunity is for a People Operations Manager to run day-to-day people operations for a globally distributed team of approximately 135 employees across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, France, Spain, and other locations. The role owns employee lifecycle operations, HR systems, benefits administration, multi-country compliance, EOR coordination, people data, reporting, and operational automation.

This position is heavily focused on accurate execution in Justworks and Deel, with most transaction volume in the United States and more complex international employment work across multiple countries. The role partners directly with the VP of People and carries real ownership over how People Operations processes, systems, documentation, and data infrastructure are built and improved.

What You'll Do

Employee lifecycle operations

Own new hire setup end to end in Justworks, including onboarding records, tax setup, benefits enrollment, and systems access.
Own employee exits end to end, including termination processing, final pay, benefits continuation, equity coordination with Finance, and access removal.
Process every employee change with clean documentation, including compensation, title, level, manager, location, and employment status updates.
Manage employment documentation, contracts, amendments, and letters across United States and international entities.
Serve as first-line support for employee questions related to pay, benefits, leave, time off, and policy.
Maintain and improve the People Operations knowledge base and process documentation.

International employment and compliance

Own the people compliance calendar across each operating country, including filings, registrations, statutory deadlines, and annual returns.
Run the operational relationship with EOR partners, including hires, employee changes, exits, invoicing, and issue resolution.
Track country-specific employment requirements, including statutory leave, notice periods, probation rules, and termination requirements.
Escalate country-specific employment and compliance questions to Legal when judgment or interpretation is needed.
Support new country openings from the operational side in partnership with EOR and legal partners.
Serve as the operational point of contact for EMEA and APAC employees.
Keep employee records accurate, complete, and audit-ready across every entity.

Benefits administration

Administer United States and international benefits day to day, including enrollments, changes, terminations, invoicing, and vendor coordination.
Execute open enrollment from setup and communications through employee support and audit.
Administer leaves of absence in coordination with the PEO, EOR, and Legal.

Systems and data

Own data integrity in the HR system of record, including audits, permissions, workflows, and integrations.
Execute consolidation into a single global system of record in partnership with the VP of People on sequencing and implementation.
Build and maintain recurring people reporting, including headcount, attrition, and organization data used by Finance and leadership.
Maintain the level, band, and job architecture data behind the leveling and compensation framework so leadership planning data remains reliable.
Automate manual People Operations work by redesigning spreadsheet- and calendar-based processes with available tools, including AI.
Use AI in operational work, including drafting documentation and letters, summarizing country policy differences, auditing records against source systems, and creating first-pass reporting.
Share effective AI prompts, templates, and short walkthroughs with the People team so recurring work becomes faster and more consistent.

Qualifications

Required Experience

4+ years of experience in people operations.
Experience in a high-growth software company under 500 people is ideal.
Direct, hands-on experience running people operations for a multi-country workforce.
Hands-on multi-country workforce experience must include the United States and United Kingdom.
Experience with Canada, European Union countries, or APAC is a strong plus.
Benefits administration experience, including running a PEO or HRIS platform as the system of record.
Justworks experience is a strong plus.

Required Skills

Fluency with spreadsheets and HR data for people reporting, data quality, audits, and operational tracking.
Working fluency with AI tools in day-to-day operational work, including specific examples of processes automated or made faster.
Strong follow-through, with the ability to own work fully, close loops without being asked, and prevent operational items from falling through.
Excellent judgment when handling confidential employee, compliance, compensation, and employment information.
Clear and direct written communication for employee support, process documentation, reporting, policy summaries, letters, and internal templates.
Ability to work quickly and precisely inside HR systems while leaving behind accurate, trustworthy records.
Ability to diagnose process issues, identify why systems or records disagree, and recommend durable operational fixes.
Ability to turn messy or partially defined People Operations projects into clear plans, workflows, and documentation.

Total rewards exposure, such as compensation cycle administration or benefits renewal support.
Experience with an HRIS migration or consolidation.

The People & Culture Specialist leads day-to-day employee relations, leave, and accommodation work for the Firm's multi-state workforce. Lead the day-to-day employee relations process for assigned matters, including intake, issue assessment, fact-finding, interviews, investigations, findings, recommendations, communication, documentation, and follow-up.

Working knowledge of employment practices and multi-state requirements, including California, Colorado, Texas, Washington, Virginia and Georgia; ability to research and apply requirements in additional jurisdictions as the Firm expands.
Experience in a law firm, professional services, or a rapidly growing multi-state organization is preferred.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, SharePoint, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as Adobe, Slack, and Zoom.
Reliable remote work setup, including high-speed internet and a functional workstation.

Takes initiative and follows work through to completion; translates broad goals into clear deliverables, milestones, ownership, and regular updates.
Exercises sound judgment, balances employee care with consistent policy application, and knows when to consult or escalate.
Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills, interacting with employees, MAs, managers, and leaders at all levels with professionalism, empathy, and clarity through phone, video, email, and messaging platforms.
Organizes multiple sensitive matters effectively, prioritizes deadlines, and maintains reliable documentation and follow-up.
Builds trust while handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
Uses facts and available data to identify patterns, explain options, and make practical recommendations.
Works independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively across teams and adapting to changing business needs.

Who Are We.

At Network Solutions, we’ve been trusted for decades to help people get online and stay ahead. We’ve been here since the beginning of the internet, and we’re still building for what comes next.

As the original digital identity authority, we help secure domain names, protect brands, and safeguard the infrastructure businesses rely on. We empower our customers to own and manage the assets that define them online, while delivering enterprise-grade security to protect against virtual threats. Our team leverages modern, AI-accelerated tools to streamline how businesses manage their digital presence, making the most of our decades of experience.

The Network Solutions team is here to help online businesses protect what’s theirs and build for tomorrow. That’s why millions trust us to protect their domains, brands, and websites every day.

We're looking for an HR Business Partner to support our Sales and Marketing teams. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives working closely with business leaders — helping them make better people decisions, building high-performing teams, and driving a strong employee experience.

You'll own the full HRBP remit for these functions: from day-to-day advisory to org design, performance, engagement, and employee relations. You'll work cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition, Compensation, and L&D, and partner with global HR teams to ensure consistency across regions.

This is a great opportunity to build strong HR fundamentals while influencing key decisions on high-impact teams.

What You’ll Do & How You’ll Make an Impact.

Business Partnership

Act as the primary HR partner for Sales and Marketing leaders — a trusted advisor on all people-related topics
Develop a deep understanding of each function's priorities, team dynamics, and challenges
Work closely with global HR and business teams to ensure alignment and consistency across regions

People Programs

Drive and support core HR cycles: performance reviews, goal setting, mid-year check-ins, compensation changes, and promotions
Partner with Talent Acquisition, Compensation, and L&D to support business needs and fill capability gaps
Analyze people data — attrition, engagement scores, headcount trends — to surface risks and inform leadership decisions

Team Effectiveness & Engagement

Support leaders in building high-performing teams; diagnose engagement gaps and follow through on action plans
Partner on org design and headcount planning discussions as teams scale or restructure

Employee Relations & Compliance

Manage employee relations matters including performance improvement plans, investigations, and reasonable accommodation requests
Ensure people practices comply with applicable federal and state employment laws (FLSA, FMLA, ADA, Title VII, and relevant state law)

Who You Are & What You’ll Need to Succeed.

3–6 years of HR experience, with at least 1-2 years in an HRBP or equivalent role
Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
Experience working with Sales or Marketing teams is a strong plus
Exposure to sales compensation or incentive plan design is an added advantage
Familiarity with Workday or a similar HRIS
Prior involvement in compensation reviews, workforce planning, or org design discussions
You build credibility with leaders quickly — through follow-through, good judgment, and directness
You navigate ambiguous situations and competing priorities without waiting for perfect information
You're comfortable working across all levels, from front-line managers to senior leaders
You bring structure and pragmatism to problems — identifying practical solutions, not just frameworks

Why You’ll Love Us.

Work-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
We care about you. We provide excellent Health Insurance options to fit you, HSA, Medical, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K, Life/AD&D/STD/LTD, Tuition Reimbursement, Pet Insurance, Generous vacation policy, and much more!
Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers.

Kiss My Apps
— це незалежна компанія-платформа, що запускає та розвиває В2С-бізнеси за допомогою Product Engine — AI-інфраструктури, що обʼєднує аналітику, розробку, маркетинг та платежі.

Сьогодні на базі платформи масштабуються 20+ B2C-бізнесів, якими користуються 130+ мільйонів користувачів у 150+ країнах світу.

З кінця 2022 року Kiss My Apps зросла у понад 70 разів, об‘єднавши 300+ спеціалістів, які створюють цифрові продукти в нішах utilities, lifestyle, health & fitness і не тільки.

Наш темп — це наш competitive advantage. KMA зростає мінімум х3 рік до року
— і ми шукаємо HR Business Partner
— того/ту, хто допоможе масштабуватись ще швидше.

Коротко про роль:

Ти станеш HR-партнером для менеджерів усіх рівнів — від frontline до C-level — і допомагатимеш їм управляти командами через бізнес-логіку, Performance Management і дані. Твоя зона відповідальності охоплюватиме розвиток менеджерської зрілості, Performance & Talent Review, calibration і складні people-рішення. Це можливість отримати повний оунершіп за ключові HR-процеси та безпосередньо впливати на ефективність команд і бізнес-результати компанії.

Твої задачі:

Бути HR-партнером для менеджерів різних рівнів і допомагати їм приймати people-рішення відповідно до бізнес-цілей команд.
Драйвити повний цикл Performance & Talent Review на базі 12 Boxes.
Інтегрувати результати Performance Review у promotion, compensation, IDP і PIP-рішення.
Проводити calibration-сесії та забезпечувати консистентність оцінювання між різними юнітами.
Формувати Talent Map команд, визначати Hi-Po, ризики відтоку, succession gaps і потреби в розвитку.
Розвивати менеджерську зрілість через коучинг, роботу зі складними кейсами та підвищення якості фідбеку.
Допомагати менеджерам працювати з headcount planning, бюджетами, cost efficiency та обґрунтовувати HC-запити через ROI.
Відстежувати ключові метрики здоров’я команд, формувати рекомендації та ескалювати системні ризики.
Впроваджувати AI-рішення для аналізу фідбеку, виявлення аномалій і ризиків та автоматизації Talent-процесів.

Що очікуємо від тебе:

Від 3 років досвіду на позиції HR Business Partner або Senior HR Generalist у продуктовому чи технологічному бізнесі. Практичний досвід партнерства з менеджерами різних рівнів — від frontline до C-level.
Досвід проведення повного циклу Performance Review.
Знання та практичний досвід роботи з Performance-Potential матрицями, зокрема 9-box або 12-box.
Досвід участі в headcount planning, HR-бюджетуванні та прийнятті рішень з урахуванням бізнес-показників.
Сильне аналітичне мислення та вміння перетворювати дані на конкретні рекомендації для бізнесу.
Навички коучингу менеджерів, фасилітації calibration-сесій і проведення складних розмов.
Розуміння P&L, cost efficiency, Revenue per FTE та зв’язку між people-рішеннями й результатами бізнесу.
Самостійність і готовність брати повний оунершіп за свій напрям.

Буде перевагою:

Досвід упровадження AI-інструментів або автоматизацій у Performance і Talent процеси.
Практичний досвід створення Talent Map, HR-дашбордів або систем раннього виявлення ризиків.
Досвід роботи з командами або функціями загальною чисельністю від 120 співробітників.

Що ти отримаєш у цій ролі:

Можливість напряму впливати на якість менеджменту та ефективність команд.
Повний оунершіп за Performance & Talent Review на рівні компанії.
Роботу з менеджерами всіх рівнів — від frontline до C-level.
Простір для створення системної роботи з талантами як AI-based продукту.
Середовище, де HR-рішення пов’язані з P&L, бюджетами та реальними бізнес-результатами.

Ми пропонуємо:

Формат роботи на твій вибір: fully remote з будь-якої точки вільного світу, а також доступ до одного з наших офісів за бажанням (Київ, Варшава).
Умови, завдяки яким ти можеш сфокусуватись на перформансі: гідна винагорода, що відповідає твоїм скілам та досвіду. А також ми забезпечуємо технікою незалежно від формату роботи та географії.
Кар’єрне зростання через дію: 80%+ усіх leads в Kiss My Apps ще 2-3 роки тому були світчерами. Твій вплив тут не визначається роками в резюме — він визначається тим, як швидко ти навчаєшся, береш відповідальність та береш оунершіп за власну карʼєру.
Well-being програма: ми турбуємося про ментальне здоровʼя команди, а також проводимо онлайн-заняття з йоги двічі на тиждень.
Розвиток та професійна реалізація: проводимо внутрішні speaking clubs англійською з нейтів спікером, а також надаємо можливість виступати на внутрішніх та зовнішніх івентах від Kiss My Apps. Крім цього ти матимеш річний бюджет на покриття до 50% професійних конференції, освітніх подій та івентів.
Додаткові бенефіти, де ти обираєш: надаємо фіксований бюджет на рік з якого ти сам обираєш, яку статтю витрат покрити: 50% від медстрахування, психотерапії, спорту чи стоматології. А також 40 днів оплачуваного відпочинку та лікарняних без привʼязки до дат.
Опора в умовах війни: забезпечуємо кожного всім необхідним для безперебійної роботи, системно підтримуємо Сили Оборони та долучаємось до ініціатив із відновлення України.

Інтро з рекрутером

Тестове завдання
Фінальна співбесіда
